english.note: Use this when extensive means a considerable quantity or amount, as in extensive research, data, or work.

exampleSentences.english: We did extensive research to write this report.
exampleSentences.traditional: 為咗寫呢份報告，我哋做咗大量研究。
exampleSentences.jyutping: wai6 zo2 se2 ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 zou6 zo2 daai6 loeng6 jin4 gau3

english.note: Use this before a noun when major refers to a large amount, number, or extent.

exampleSentences.english: This organization receives a major volume of donations every year.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間機構每年都收到大量捐款。
